name: Preschool
headline: Big discoveries. Ready for kindergarten.
intro: Growing Kids preschool builds academic, social and physical skills through hands-on learning. Children explore new ideas, practice everyday skills and make friends as they get ready for kindergarten.
alt: A child practicing writing at a classroom table
learn: Taking turns, making friends and naming feelings
day: Time with teachers and familiar friends helps children settle into the day.
Stories, math games, science and hands-on activities bring learning to life.
Classroom routines make room for meals, rest and indoor or outdoor play.
Art, pretend play and time together give children ways to practice new skills.
bring: Ask your center for its classroom supply list, rest-time items and guidance on extra clothing. Share any care needs with your director before your child’s first day.

quotes.name: Kelsey
quotes.quote: My children have always called daycare “school” and that’s just what it is. The children have time to play of course, but everything they do is centered on learning.

quotes.name: Sarah
quotes.quote: My three year old in the last month’s vocabulary has exploded and I know much of that is thanks to your teachers.

name: Infants
headline: A gentle beginning, together.
intro: Growing Kids infant care welcomes babies from six weeks until walking. Individual attention, familiar feeding and nap routines and daily communication help families stay connected as babies grow.
alt: A baby sleeping in a colorful infant room seat
learn: Exploring through touch, sight and sound
day: Feeding and sleep routines follow your baby’s needs.
Teachers offer individual attention and comfort.
Share changes in routines and care needs with your child’s teachers.
bring: Review the infant feeding plan, breast milk procedures and safe sleep information with your center. Your teacher will explain what to label and bring.

quotes.name: Kayla
quotes.quote: Our infant room teachers have been so wonderful and take such great care of our daughter while we are at work.

quotes.name: Nicole
quotes.quote: We are incredibly happy with Growing Kids. The Director is personable, friendly and always upbeat.

name: Toddlers and Young Preschool
headline: Small steps. A bigger world.
intro: Growing Kids toddler and young preschool care gives children from walking to age 3 room to move, explore and connect. Stories, art and hands-on play help children practice language, independence and friendships.
alt: A young child exploring paint during a classroom activity
day: A familiar teacher and routine help with the transition from home.
Arts, crafts and stories invite hands-on exploration.
Indoor and outdoor play give growing bodies room to move.
Meals, rest and familiar routines support the day.
bring: Ask your center about extra clothes, rest-time items and toileting supplies. Teachers can help you plan for your child’s current stage.

quotes.name: Brittney
quotes.quote: Teachers are very personable and develop great relationships with the kids. My son LOVED being in the toddler class he was excited for school and always got excited when I asked him if he wanted to go see his teachers.

quotes.name: Brooke
quotes.quote: All of the teachers in the Toddler 2 room have been so amazing with Sam, there was no question that Mason wouldn’t be safe and cared for as well.

name: School Age Care
headline: Before school. After school. Still growing.
intro: Growing Kids school age care supports children ages 5 to 12 before and after school, with care during school breaks and closures. Children have time for homework, indoor and outdoor play and friendships.
alt: Children playing together outdoors at Growing Kids
day: A familiar place to start the school day.
Group activities and free play make room to reconnect.
Teachers provide guidance during time set aside for homework.
Ask your center about full-day care, school transportation and upcoming closures.
bring: Check transportation arrangements and permission forms with your center. Bring schoolwork when needed and ask about supplies for full-day care.

quotes.name: Marissa
quotes.quote: My kids have attended daycare, after school care and summer camp here. We are definitely happy with the services and curriculum.

quotes.name: Jeni
quotes.quote: We still use GK for summer camp, winter camp, spring camp, and the occasional day off school. Our family loves the teachers and staff at GK.

name: Camps
headline: School’s out. Curiosity stays.
intro: Growing Kids camps give children ages 5 to 12 hands-on activities, friendships and opportunities to explore during summer and school breaks. Ask your center for its current camp schedule and planned trips.
alt: Children enjoying an outdoor play area
learn: Exploring new places on planned trips
day: Children join familiar faces and meet new friends.
Hands-on projects bring art and science into the day.
Outdoor play gives children time to move and explore.
Field trips vary by center and season. Ask about the current schedule.
bring: Your center will provide the current camp packing list and field-trip permissions. Confirm clothing, meals and any trip-specific items before camp begins.

quotes.name: Cara
quotes.quote: We were very happy with the Summer Camp that our son participated in. They went on field trips often and each provided a different and exciting learning experience.

quotes.name: Brooke
quotes.quote: He is having a great time at camp and we appreciate the combination of learning and fun.
